claims.statement: Across the five sheets, footwear, hair from behind, cuffs and interior floors are mostly not documented for the person on the date; sheets mark them N and keep proposals as D.

Four production conflicts surfaced: Caesar residence (Via Sacra, not Palatine) and short sleeves in R2-wardrobe-caesar; Napoleon season (spring, not autumn), no December 1816 new rooms, carpet over deal floor and contested green coat; Oppenheimer has no documented private room that night; Genghis table is a narrative exception. Revision 1: the Galileo floor is not a factual conflict (undocumented); Napoleon room dimensions are unresolved.

Local reference images viewed and hashed per sheet; several contradict sources (broach, sandals, armour, rings, wristwatch, red piping, short sleeves). Revision 1 withdraws 'plank floors contradict the only floor hint' and 'new, not worn' (Napoleon coat shows wear).
